title: Staging Infrastructure, PostgreSQL Migration Readiness & Deployment Blocker Resolution

json_storage_concurrency.risk_analysis: MemoryCache in json_manager.py is process-local with a 3.0s TTL. Spawning multiple uvicorn workers causes stale in-memory read states, split-brain stock allocations, and missed coupon limits. Multi-worker uvicorn is strictly blocked until PostgreSQL is enabled.

fixes_applied: Decoupled backend/app/api/wishlist.py from direct json_db import to dynamic get_db() adapter

client_ip_trusted_proxy_hardening.spoofing_protection: Direct peer IP must be contained in TRUSTED_PROXIES before accepting X-Forwarded-For headers
client_ip_trusted_proxy_hardening.cookie_preservation: Fixed api_response_wrapper to preserve raw set-cookie headers

root_causes_identified: Deadlock in Playwright CDP response handler caused by reading response bodies via resp.text() on streamed binary responses
Module script race condition in admin.js where DOMContentLoaded listener failed to fire when document was already complete
fixes_applied: Replaced response body snooping with DOM state assertions in E2E test runner
Restored set-cookie preservation in backend/app/main.py response wrapper

razorpay_status.reason: Mock credentials present in development environment; live payment verification blocked until staging keys are provisioned
